source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Held-out v0.2 Review Queue candidates source-reviewed directly against the user-provided purchased book. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: Denya Jinja
entities.source_summary: Active Shinto shrine and cultural site where visitors can make offerings, draw fortunes, buy charms and watch cultural performances; the source explicitly distinguishes it from a tourist gift-shop attraction.
entities.catalogue_note: Only source-explicit shrine charms are modeled as wares; this is not expanded into a general souvenir shop.

entities.name: Dilly’s
entities.source_summary: Privacy-focused love hotel near Network 54 Plaza, with hourly room passes and in-room vendits selling food, drink, testing, intimate supplies, clothing and souvenir shirts.

local_offerings.label: Marked-up food and drinks, including alcohol

entities.catalogue_note: The in-room vendit stock is described generically and remains source-local rather than generating a broad retail assortment.

entities.name: Network 54 Plaza
entities.source_summary: Fortified Network 54 corporate complex containing offices, studios, restaurants, clinic, fitness spa and exclusive housing; only reception and organized show-filming or premiere visits are explicitly public.

services.label: Organized public visits to filming and premieres

entities.name: Silver Pixel Cloud
entities.source_summary: Drive-in movie theater popular with nomads, showing classic and new films and hosting recurring themed screenings with live reenactments.

services.label: Recurring themed screenings and live reenactments

entities.name: ValueMart Village
entities.source_summary: Former big-box store converted into dense cube-and-cargo housing with an adjacent tent settlement; rent collectors visit residents regularly.

entities.name: WorldSat Communications Offices
entities.source_summary: Highly secured and mostly automated WorldSat communications facility forming Night City's principal external communications link; the source describes infrastructure, not a public outlet.
